materials.name: Standard build (as catalogued)
materials.description: Carbon steel; quenched & tempered link plates; case-hardened bushes and rollers (sintered-hardened or cast rollers on some large-roller types); solid or hollow bearing pins per series

materials.name: Nickel-plated
materials.description: Carbon-steel chain with (electroless) nickel plating applied to the parts before assembly; strength essentially as carbon steel (one catalogue limits plated chain to 80 % of tensile)

materials.name: Polymer rollers (acetal / nylon)
materials.description: Plastic rollers for quiet, low-friction running; lower roller load capacity

materials.name: Stainless steel (304 / 300-series)
materials.description: Austenitic stainless; working load is substantially reduced versus carbon steel (catalogues quote roughly 2/3 of carbon-steel tensile and much lower allowable load). Some makers fit precipitation-hardened pins as standard in this grade

materials.name: Zinc-plated (electro-galvanised)
materials.description: Carbon-steel chain with zinc plating; for light corrosion; One catalogue limits plated chain to 80 % of tensile

description: Drop-forged rivetless chain has three forged parts per pitch: a centre link, two side links and a T-head pin that locks in without rivets. It assembles and comes apart by hand, has open joints that shed material, and is very strong for its weight. It is widely used on flight, scraper, trolley and assembly conveyors, in sizes from X-348 to 9148, including barloop versions with flat sidebars for welding attachments.
drawing_title: Rivetless chain — X-type

description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

series: twin-strand forged link (fork-link) conveyor chain 216 x 62 x 28,5 mm
description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

Drop-forged rivetless chain has three forged parts per pitch: a centre link, two side links and a T-head pin that locks in without rivets. It assembles and comes apart by hand, has open joints that shed material, and is very strong for its weight. It is widely used on flight, scraper, trolley and assembly conveyors, in sizes from X-348 to 9148, including barloop versions with flat sidebars for welding attachments.

series: twin-strand forged link (fork-link) conveyor chain 250 x 50 x 25 mm (with side slot)
description: Drop-forged chain is built from one-piece forged links joined by pins or bolts. The links are case-hardened, so a very hard wear surface sits over a tough, shock-resistant core. It is made for drag, en-masse, scraper and case conveyors carrying grain, wood chips, ash, cement and other abrasive bulk materials. Pitches run from 102 to 260 mm (4 to 10 in) in single, double and triple strand, with welded, clamped or bolt-on (Bolt 'N' Go) flights.

series: Engineering Class Rivetless Chain - alloy steel (Rivetless/Cat Dog)
description: Drop-forged rivetless chain has three forged parts per pitch: a centre link, two side links and a T-head pin that locks in without rivets. It assembles and comes apart by hand, has open joints that shed material, and is very strong for its weight. It is widely used on flight, scraper, trolley and assembly conveyors, in sizes from X-348 to 9148, including barloop versions with flat sidebars for welding attachments.
